title: Delicious Weeknight Pregnancy Menus: 5 Cook-Once Recipes
excerpt: Five flavorful recipes for busy evenings — soup, stir-fry, egg dishes and yogurt parfaits — balanced for protein, fiber and calcium.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, eating a balanced and nutritious diet is crucial for the health of both mother and baby. However, with busy lives, many pregnant women struggle to prepare healthy and delicious meals. In this article, we will introduce 5 simple and tasty cook-once recipes, perfect for busy weeknights.

## Nutrient Analysis
The recipes below are designed to provide adequate protein, fiber, and calcium, essential nutrients for the health of mother and baby. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), pregnant women should consume about 70-100g of protein per day, along with 25-30g of fiber and 1,000mg of calcium.

## 5 Cook-Once Recipes
### 1. Chicken and Vegetable Soup
Chicken soup is a nutritious and easy-to-digest meal, perfect for pregnant women. To make chicken soup, you will need:
- 1 chicken (about 1kg)
- 2 carrots
- 2 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 2 liters of water

Cook all the ingredients for 30 minutes, then strain the broth and serve with rice or bread.

### 2. Chicken Stir-Fry with Broccoli
Chicken stir-fry with broccoli is an excellent choice for dinner. To make this dish, you will need:
- 200g of chicken breast
- 1 bunch of broccoli
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 tablespoon of oil
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar

Stir-fry all the ingredients for 10 minutes, then serve with rice or noodles.

### 3. Fried Eggs with Salad
Fried eggs are a rich source of protein, while salad provides fiber and vitamins. To make this dish, you will need:
- 2 eggs
- 1 bunch of lettuce
- 1 carrot
- 1 cucumber
- 1 tablespoon of oil
- 1 teaspoon of salt

Cook the eggs for 5 minutes, then serve with salad.

### 4. Yogurt Parfait with Fruit
Yogurt parfait is a delicious and nutritious dessert, providing calcium and protein. To make this dish, you will need:
- 1 cup of yogurt
- 1 bunch of fruit (strawberries, kiwi, banana)
- 1 tablespoon of sugar
- 1 tablespoon of walnuts

Mix all the ingredients for 5 minutes, then serve as a dessert.

### 5. Grilled Cheese Sandwich with Tomato
Grilled cheese sandwich with tomato is a simple but nutritious meal. To make this dish, you will need:
- 2 slices of bread
- 2 slices of cheese
- 1 tomato
- 1 tablespoon of oil
- 1 teaspoon of salt

Cook the cheese sandwich for 5 minutes, then serve with tomato.

## Practical Tips
- To ensure food safety, choose fresh ingredients and cook thoroughly.
- Drink plenty of water and eat a variety of fruits and vegetables.
- If you have any questions or concerns about your diet, consult your doctor or a registered dietitian.

## When to Seek Help
If you experience any of the following symptoms, seek medical attention:
- Abdominal pain or bleeding
- Fever or chills
- Nausea or vomiting

faqs.question: How much protein should I consume daily when pregnant?

faqs.question: What foods can I eat to provide adequate calcium when pregnant?
